Ava: Hey team — final draft of the launch blog is ready. Need quick sync on publish window + asset gating. I attached the doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/abc123 :eyes:
Diego: linking... reading now. Quick Q: do we have the revised benchmark numbers for the hero chart?
Ava: yes — updated numbers are in slide 3 of the doc. We used 3 runs and median latency.
Lena: need legal check on the "enterprise SLA" phrasing. @Mira can you confirm compliance/legal signoff timeline?
Mira: can do. Legal needs 24-48h. Put 'subject to SLA' in parentheses for now.
Sam: hero image ready but need exact dimensions. Prefer 1200x630 for socials.
Diego: I'll swap assets. Also routing: can we add hidden UTM for partner leads? HubSpot form needs field mapping.
Ava: HubSpot mapping: campaign=ri_product_launch_2026, source=blog, utm_medium=organic. @Mira will review.
publish-bot: scheduled post draft created for 2026-06-10 16:00 UTC. ID: pub-9876
Diego: can we move to 2026-06-10 12:00 UTC? earlier gets better APAC coverage.
Ava: ok moved to 12:00 UTC.
Mira: legal cleared the "enterprise SLA" wording. Approved with minor edits — see doc comment.
Lena: product-approved. small nit: add note about Dedicated vs Hosted differences in teardown section.
Sam: uploaded revised hero and mobile crops to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/xyz789
Diego: final runbook for publish: 1) Replace hero, 2) paste canonical link, 3) run smoke test, 4) enable form. I'll paste below
Diego: ```
# Publish checklist
- update hero image
- verify og:image + meta tags
- confirm canonical
- enable hubspot form (campaign: ri_product_launch_2026)
- spot-check render on mobile
- post on twitter & linkedin w/ assets
```
Ava: perfect. who owns social copy? @Lena
Lena: I'll draft social. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Mira: legal wants attribution for benchmark dataset: 'bench corp 2025 release' added.
Ava: added. Last call — anything else?
Sam: bump for design QA before EOD Friday.
Diego: LGTM. :thumbsup:
Ava: thanks all. I'll hit publish checklist on the day. Posting reminder in #launch-day channel 4h before.
